acceptance_criteria.criterion: createItemsPerPageSelector returns an HTMLTag <select> with correct options and onchange JS
Effective items-per-page value is marked as selected
Pagination row renders when items-per-page options are configured even if totalPages <= 1
Pagination row does NOT render when totalPages <= 1 and no items-per-page options (backward compat)
Page navigation links are only shown when totalPages > 1
Selector is appended after page-jump input in the pagination <td>

summary: Implemented createItemsPerPageSelector() in BaseGridRenderer — builds XSS-safe <select> with onchange JS using json_encode() on the URL template, marks effective IPP as selected.
Updated renderPaginationRow() in BaseGridRenderer and Bootstrap5Renderer: changed early-return guard to render the row when hasItemsPerPageOptions() is true even if totalPages <= 1.
Updated createPaginationRow() in BaseGridRenderer: wrapped <nav> page links conditionally on totalPages > 1; appended selector after page-jump input when hasItemsPerPageOptions().
Updated createBootstrapPaginationRow() in Bootstrap5Renderer: same conditional <nav> pattern; appended createItemsPerPageSelector().
Overrode createItemsPerPageSelector() in Bootstrap5Renderer: adds form-select form-select-sm Bootstrap classes and wraps in a d-flex align-items-center gap-2 mt-2 container <div>.
All 112 tests pass (0 failures). PHPStan level 6: No errors.

comments.note: BaseGridRenderer.createPaginationRow() accumulates conditional content by appending to $td sequentially — this is readable and correct. No concerns found in the touched files.
Bootstrap5Renderer.createBootstrapPaginationRow() still carries a WP-005 comment that should now read WP-003; updated in this pass.

summary: All 6 acceptance criteria verified. 112/112 tests pass (0 failures). PHPStan level 6: 0 errors. No regressions. Implementation follows established XSS-safety pattern (json_encode) and HTMLTag-only HTML building convention.

comments.note: No renderer-level unit tests exist for createItemsPerPageSelector(), or for the renderPaginationRow() visibility logic changes. Existing tests cover GridPagination model methods only. Recommend adding renderer output tests in a future test suite (RendererPaginationTest) to snapshot-test the pagination row HTML under various IPP + totalPages combinations.

Bootstrap5Renderer.createItemsPerPageSelector() returns a <div> wrapper (not a bare <select>), which is the correct Bootstrap 5 pattern. The div carries d-flex/align-items-center/gap-2/mt-2 classes and an inline style='width:auto' on the select — consistent with the Bootstrap spec from WP-003.

Edge case verified: 0-item grid with IPP options configured — renderPaginationRow() correctly skips the nav block (getTotalPages() == 0 <= 1) and renders only the IPP selector. This allows users to change the page size even when the current filter yields no results — desirable UX.

summary: Reviewed BaseGridRenderer.createItemsPerPageSelector() and Bootstrap5Renderer.createItemsPerPageSelector() / renderPaginationRow() / createBootstrapPaginationRow(). All four Review Dimensions pass.

Security: json_encode($urlTemplate, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR) correctly produces a JSON string literal for the JS onchange handler; the IPP value is always this.value from server-controlled <option> integers. XSS vector is properly closed.

Correctness: renderPaginationRow() guard logic (totalPages <= 1 && !hasIPPOptions) correctly preserves backward compatibility. createPaginationRow() and createBootstrapPaginationRow() both gate the <nav> block on totalPages > 1 and append the selector unconditionally when options exist.
Conventions: HTMLTag-only HTML building throughout; no raw string concatenation. Return types are declared. declare(strict_types=1) is present. Fluent API returns self.
Two minor non-blocking observations recorded below — no blocking issues found.

comments.note: Bootstrap5Renderer.createBootstrapPaginationRow() is declared private. Every other builder helper in BaseGridRenderer (createPreviousLink, createPageLink, createEllipsis, createPageJumpInput, etc.) is protected, matching the Template Method pattern for subclass customization. Making createBootstrapPaginationRow() protected would allow a future Bootstrap5Renderer subclass to override just the row structure without replacing the entire renderPaginationRow() method. Non-blocking; no current subclass is affected.

Bootstrap5Renderer.createItemsPerPageSelector() returns a <div> wrapper tag while the parent BaseGridRenderer.createItemsPerPageSelector() returns the bare <select> tag. Both are typed as HTMLTag, so the semantic divergence is invisible to callers. A short doc comment on the Bootstrap override stating 'Returns a flex wrapper <div> containing the <select>' would prevent confusion if a future developer calls the method and tries to add select-level attributes to the result. Non-blocking by design.

summary: Updated docs/agents/project-manifest/api-surface.md: added createItemsPerPageSelector() to BaseGridRenderer pagination block (with XSS-safety and override notes); added createItemsPerPageSelector() override to Bootstrap5Renderer (with flex-wrapper and Bootstrap class details); updated renderPaginationRow() visibility comment in both renderers to reflect new IPP guard logic; updated Bootstrap5Renderer comment header to reference WP-003.

Updated docs/agents/project-manifest/data-flows.md: updated Section 2 (Rendering Pipeline) footer note to document the new pagination row visibility rule (shows when IPP options configured, even on 0-item grids); updated Section 5 (Pagination Usage) output diagrams for both DefaultRenderer and Bootstrap5Renderer to show the conditional <nav> block and the IPP <select>/<div> block; updated the closing NOTE to reflect the new guard condition.

Updated README.md: added 'Built-in items-per-page selector' subsection under Usage, covering setItemsPerPageOptions(), resolveItemsPerPage(), backward compatibility, visibility rule, Bootstrap 5 wrapper styling, and GET parameter name customisation.

comments.note: README.md previously documented only the manual settings() approach for items-per-page. The new 'Built-in items-per-page selector' section complements it cleanly — both patterns are now discoverable. No redundancy conflict.

api-surface.md BaseGridRenderer section previously tagged pagination methods as '(WP-005)' only. Updated to '(WP-005 / WP-003)' to reflect that WP-003 added createItemsPerPageSelector() and changed the renderPaginationRow() visibility guard. Downstream agents can trace both WPs for context.

notes: WP-003 introduces createItemsPerPageSelector() in BaseGridRenderer (protected, overridable). Bootstrap5Renderer overrides it to add Bootstrap classes and a flex wrapper. Both renderers now show the pagination row when IPP options are configured. All 112 tests pass, PHPStan level 6 clean.

WP-003 QA PASS. All 6 ACs met, 112 tests pass, PHPStan level 6 clean. No regressions. Implementation is XSS-safe and follows project conventions. Minor observation: no renderer-level unit tests for the new IPP selector HTML output — noted as low-priority coverage gap for future work.

WP-003 PASS. All 6 ACs confirmed. XSS-safe, HTMLTag-only, PHPStan-clean, backward-compatible. Two low-priority non-blocking suggestions recorded: (1) consider making createBootstrapPaginationRow() protected for subclass extensibility; (2) add a doc comment to Bootstrap5Renderer.createItemsPerPageSelector() noting it returns a <div> wrapper, not a bare <select>. Documentation can proceed.
